main_text.p: Numer. Præceptor. Cap.VI. ribus secundum legem à Mose præscriptam.
Obserυ. 365 Nazaræus non bibet vinum 6. 3 neque aliquid in quo vinum est.
Obserυ. 366 Non edet humidas uvas. ib. 3
Obserυ. 368 Non edet de cute uvarum. ib. 4
Obserυ. 369 Non nucleum in uvis. ib. 4
Obserυ. 370 Non debet tondere Nazaræib. 5 omnes capillos toto tempore voti sui.
Obserυ. 371 Faciet crescere capillos suos. ib. 5
N.obs. 372 Non ingredietur domum ib. 6 mortuorum.
N.obs. 373 Non debet le mortuis pollue- ib. 7 re.
N.obs. 374 Tondet crines tempore sa-ib. 9 crificii sui cum implerit tempus Nazareatus, vel alio tempore si pol- lutus erit.
Obserυ. 375 Bene dicent sacerdotes Israe- 6.23 litis.
N.obs. 376 Portabunt Levitæ arcam su- 7 10 pra humeros suos.
N.obs. 377 Facient Pascha secundum fe- 9. 11 cundo menle.

page.notes: Marginal references ib., 6.3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 6.23, 7 10, 9. 11 are printed in the outer margin; the marginal numerals are transcribed beside their lines. Some words in the observation lines are uncertain in the scan (e.g. Obserυ. abbreviations); the "Obserυ" marks are read as "Observ." and the "N.obs." marks as "N.obf.". Catchword absent.
